'''Yūki Kaji''' (Japanese: '''梶裕貴''' ''Kaji Yūki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Kaji was born in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} on September 3, 1985 and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Kaji began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} near the end of {{aniseries|BW}}, where he portrayed Pokémon rescuer [[Virgil]]. Shortly afterwards, he gained more prominent roles in {{aniseries|XY}}, playing {{an|Clemont}}, one of {{ashfr|Ash's traveling partners}}, and the {{p|Zygarde}} [[nickname]]d [[Squishy]] and [[Z2]]. Kaji is currently affiliated with the talent group VIMS.
